description: This file defines the AuthService class that provides authentication functions such as login and token refresh within a Spring Boot based backend. It interacts with authentication management, user details loading, and JWT token utilities.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class handling user authentication, including login and token refresh functionalities, using JWT tokens.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates the user with provided username and password, generates access and refresh tokens, and returns them.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token; throws exception if token invalid or expired.
